utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, Gus, are you sure we have the right tools for the repair drive? I don't want us to get halfway there and realize we're missing something.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Don’t you worry, Pia—I’ve got my whole truck bed full of gear, from wrenches to a spare air compressor. We’ll sort it out right now if you want to double-check.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Alright, let's go through the list. I'd hate to be stranded out there with a busted drive and no way to fix it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Uli, are you free this weekend to help organize the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I might be free. What exactly needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Mostly sorting through donated tools and setting up workstations in the community center—should take a few hours on Saturday morning if you're up for it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Nell, what's this about a repair drive? I'm in a bit of a rush, but I can help if it's quick.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, hi Bo! I just heard from a few folks that we're collecting tools and spare parts for the community center—I thought you might know more about it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Huh, first I'm hearing of it. I've got some old wrenches in my garage if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Need any tools for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I could use a good hammer if you've got one to spare.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got a solid one in my shed. I'll bring it by.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Dane, I heard you're working on that repair drive. How's it going?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, it's coming along, Rey. Took a bit longer than I expected, but I think I'm on the right track now.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That's good to hear, Dane. Anything in particular giving you trouble with it?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hey Cleo, I heard you mention a repair drive. Can you tell me more about what happened?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, yeah! It was a community thing—people brought in broken stuff, and we fixed it up together. We even swapped a few spare parts folks had lying around.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds like a great way to reuse things. Was it organized by someone specific, or did neighbors just put it together?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I think I left my toolbox somewhere... do you remember what we're fixing again?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, don't worry about that! We're fixing up old Mrs. Gable's fence and the Henderson kids' swing set — everyone's pitching in down at the park!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, right, the fence and the swing set! I knew that... I just hope I can find my wrench before we get there.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Rosa, I heard you're organizing the repair drive—count me in for Saturday morning!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's wonderful, Mara! I'll add you to the list for Saturday morning—we're starting at 9 AM at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, I'll see you at the community center at 9 AM on Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, I noticed you heading over to the repair drive earlier. Did you find the spot okay?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yeah, found it fine. Is that thing actually gonna get our street fixed, or is it just another one of those feel-good city projects?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Well, I checked the city's project map last week—it's definitely listed as a genuine repaving job, not just a pilot program.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Vik, heard about the repair drive—needs any tools dropped off? I'm heading to the hardware store.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I think they're asking for hammers and screwdrivers, I'm gonna swing by later too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Alright, I'll grab a couple extra hammers—just in case. Need me to pick anything up for your kit while I'm there?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hey Kira, sorry I'm a bit out of the loop—what's this repair drive you're talking about?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You haven't heard? It's that little event the Hendersons are organizing to fix up the old community center this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the community center! I must've missed the memo. Sounds like a good cause, though.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Eli, what's this repair drive about? Need a hand with anything?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Oh, it's just a community thing where we fix up each other's stuff. I'm planning to organize it for next Saturday morning. Could use your help setting up the sign-in table.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Eli, I'm happy to help set up the table. What time should I be there?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: So, Pia, what's the plan for this repair drive? I like to know the schedule ahead of time.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I was thinking Saturday morning at nine, so we have daylight to sort through everything. Does that work for you?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Saturday at nine works just fine for me. I'll be there with my toolbox ready.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hi Kira, I heard you're organizing a repair drive for the neighborhood? How's that going?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, I'm looking into it, but I'm still not sure enough people are committed. Have you heard anyone actually say they'd join?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh yeah, I was chatting with Mr. Henderson yesterday—he said he'd definitely bring his old lawnmower, and the Lee family mentioned they have some tools to contribute too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Cleo, you headed to that repair drive too? I could use a hand carrying some stuff.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, hi Bo! Yeah, I've got a box of old tools I'm bringing. Happy to lend a hand if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks! Let's grab my stuff and head over.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo! I'm so glad you stopped by—I wanted to chat about the neighborhood repair drive we're planning for next Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure, sounds good. What needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Well, we've got a few things on the list—the community bench is wobbly, and the fence by the park needs a new latch.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Mara, I heard you're organizing a repair drive for the neighborhood. Need any help setting up or gathering tools?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would be fantastic, Sam! I could really use a hand with organizing the tool donations. Could you help me sort through what we have?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I'd love to help sort through the tools. Just let me know when and where to meet you!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Rey, have you heard about the neighborhood repair drive this weekend? I'm helping spread the word!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I heard a little about it. What kind of repairs are they planning to do?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: They're tackling everything from patching up fences to fixing leaky faucets—just a bunch of handy neighbors pitching in!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: The repair drive is set for Saturday at the community center, right? I've got it marked on my calendar.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, yes, that's what I heard too—though I wasn't sure if the time was morning or afternoon. Do you know when it starts?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I'm pretty sure it's at 10 a.m. sharp — I saw the flyer pinned at the grocery store bulletin board.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive! I think I remember something about that... or maybe I don't. What's it about again?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, so we're getting folks together this Saturday to fix up old appliances and furniture for folks who can't afford repairs. I'm planning to bring my broken toaster and help out with minor fixes.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: A repair drive, you say? That rings a faint bell... I think I've got an old lamp that's been gathering dust. Maybe I can drag that along and lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Noah, I heard you're putting together a repair drive—count me in! I know a few folks who might want to help out too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, that's great Jules! What do you mean by repair drive again?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: You know, like fixing up broken bikes or electronics folks don't want to toss—I can rally my neighbors to bring in whatever needs mending.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Gus, did you hear about the repair drive starting up at the community center? They're collecting old appliances and electronics.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure did, Tess! I've got a whole shed full of old power tools I could donate—they just need a little TLC.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that's perfect! Martha mentioned they're especially looking for things folks can fix up and resell. Your tools would be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oh, the repair drive? Let me make sure I have the right one—did you mean the USB stick with the backup files or the one for fixing the router?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: The one for fixing the router—did you find it?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, I have it right here. I checked the label to be sure.
